medicines.useCase: High fever, headaches, mild body pain
medicines.useCaseHi: तेज बुखार, सिरदर्द और बदन दर्द में असरदार
medicines.dosageGuideline: 1 tablet after food, every 6-8 hours as required (max 4 per day).
medicines.precautions: Avoid overdose; consult doctor if fever exceeds 3 days.

medicines.categoryHi: गैस, एसिडिटी व सीने में जलन
medicines.useCaseHi: सीने में जलन, पेट में गैस, खट्टी डकार व अल्सर
medicines.dosageGuideline: 1 tablet once daily in the morning, 30 minutes before breakfast.
medicines.precautions: Take with plain water on an empty stomach.

medicines.useCase: Seasonal allergic rhinitis, sneezing, watery eyes, skin hives
medicines.useCaseHi: मौसम बदलने से होने वाली छींकें, नाक बहना, आंखों में पानी और एलर्जी
medicines.dosageGuideline: 1 tablet once daily with water, preferably evening.
medicines.precautions: Non-drowsy formulation, but avoid taking with fruit juices.

medicines.useCase: Moderate to severe body ache, toothache, muscle sprain, swelling
medicines.useCaseHi: दांत दर्द, जोड़ों का दर्द, मांसपेशियों में खिंचाव व सूजन
medicines.dosageGuideline: 1 tablet after full meal (never on empty stomach).
medicines.precautions: Not recommended for active gastric ulcer patients without medical advice.

medicines.useCase: Throat, ear, sinus, respiratory tract, and dental bacterial infections
medicines.useCaseHi: गले में इन्फेक्शन, कान का संक्रमण, छाती का कफ व दांतों का घाव
medicines.dosageGuideline: Strictly as prescribed by a doctor; complete the 5-7 days full course.
medicines.precautions: Do not skip doses. Must be taken under doctor prescription.

medicines.useCase: Common cold symptoms, insect bite itching, dust & pollen allergies
medicines.useCaseHi: धूल की एलर्जी, सामान्य सर्दी, त्वचा में लाल चकत्ते और खुजली
medicines.precautions: May cause mild drowsiness; avoid driving after taking.

medicines.useCase: Type 2 Diabetes mellitus blood sugar regulation
medicines.useCaseHi: टाइप-2 डायबिटीज में ब्लड शुगर को संतुलित रखना
medicines.dosageGuideline: Take with or immediately after meals as directed by physician.

medicines.useCase: High blood pressure (Hypertension), heart attack risk reduction
medicines.useCaseHi: हाई ब्लड प्रेशर को नियंत्रित करना और दिल पर दबाव कम करना
medicines.dosageGuideline: 1 tablet daily at fixed time (morning), with or without food.
medicines.precautions: Do not stop suddenly without consulting doctor.

medicines.useCase: Acid reflux with nausea, fullness, vomiting sensation, gastro-oesophageal reflux
medicines.useCaseHi: एसिडिटी के साथ जी मिचलाना, उल्टी का अहसास व पेट फूलना
medicines.dosageGuideline: 1 capsule daily in the morning, 30 minutes before breakfast.
medicines.precautions: Swallow whole; do not crush or chew.

medicines.useCase: Severe throat infection, chest congestion, tonsillitis, respiratory infections
medicines.useCaseHi: गले में तेज दर्द, टॉन्सिल, खांसी और छाती में जकड़न का संक्रमण
medicines.dosageGuideline: Once daily, 1 hour before or 2 hours after meals, for 3-5 days.
medicines.precautions: Requires valid prescription; finish entire prescribed course.

medicines.categoryHi: दमा, सांस की तकलीफ व एलर्जी
medicines.useCase: Allergic asthma symptoms, persistent night coughing, chronic rhinitis
medicines.useCaseHi: रात में सूखी खांसी, सांस फूलना, एलर्जिक अस्थमा व धूल से बचाव
medicines.precautions: Take consistently at the same time each evening.

medicines.useCase: Mouth ulcers, physical fatigue, nerve weakness, post-illness recovery
medicines.useCaseHi: मुंह के छाले, शारीरिक कमजोरी, भूख की कमी और नसों की शक्ति
medicines.precautions: Harmless bright yellow urine is normal while taking B-complex.

medicines.useCase: Bone mineral density, joint health, osteoporosis prevention
medicines.useCaseHi: हड्डियों व जोड़ों का दर्द, कैल्शियम की कमी और ऑस्टियोपोरोसिस
medicines.precautions: Drink plenty of water throughout the day.

medicines.useCase: High cholesterol (hyperlipidemia), prevention of cardiovascular events
medicines.useCaseHi: खून में खराब कोलेस्ट्रॉल घटाना और नसों में ब्लॉकेज से बचाव

medicines.useCase: Gastric acidity, stomach ulcers, burning sensation in chest
medicines.useCaseHi: पेट का अल्सर, जलन, खट्टी डकारें और अपच
medicines.precautions: Do not open or chew the microgranules inside the capsule.

medicines.saltName: Diclofenac Diethylamine + Linseed Oil + Methyl Salicylate
medicines.genericAlternative: Jan Aushadhi Diclofenac Pain Relief Gel 30g

medicines.useCaseHi: कमर दर्द, मोच, घुटनों की अकड़न और मांसपेशियों का खिंचाव
medicines.dosageGuideline: Apply gently on affected area 3-4 times daily without vigorous massage.
medicines.precautions: Do not apply on open cuts, wounds, or sensitive areas.

medicines.useCase: Dehydration due to diarrhoea, vomiting, summer heat exhaustion
medicines.useCaseHi: दस्त, उल्टी या तेज धूप से शरीर में पानी और नमक की कमी पूरा करना
medicines.dosageGuideline: Dissolve entire 21.8g sachet in 1 Litre of clean drinking water.
medicines.precautions: Consume within 24 hours of mixing. Do not boil prepared solution.

medicines.useCase: Prevention and treatment of nausea, motion sickness, vomiting
medicines.useCaseHi: उल्टी, जी घबराना और यात्रा के दौरान चक्कर आना रोकना
medicines.dosageGuideline: 1 tablet before travel or as advised during acute vomiting episodes.

recipes.title: Quick Leftover Roti Chivda
recipes.titleHindi: बची हुई रोटी का चटपटा चिवड़ा
ingredients: Curry Leaves & Coriander (कढ़ी पत्ता व हरा धनिया)
instructions: Tear rotis into bite-sized rough pieces or pulse coarsely in a mixer.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a kadai, crackle mustard seeds, green chilli, and curry leaves.
Add chopped onion and sauté on medium flame until translucent.
Sprinkle turmeric and salt, then add the roti pieces.
Toss continuously on medium heat for 3-4 minutes until lightly crisp.
Turn off flame, squeeze fresh lemon juice and garnish with coriander.
recipes.jugaadTip: Sprinkle 1 tbsp curd or water while tossing so stale dry rotis turn exceptionally soft inside with crisp edges!
recipes.substitutions: If no rotis, make this exact recipe using stale bread slices or leftover pav.

recipes.title: Dhaba Style Aloo Gobhi Matar
ingredients: 1 tsp Ginger-Garlic paste, 1/2 tsp Cumin seeds
Spices: Haldi, Lal Mirch, Dhania powder, Garam Masala, Salt
instructions: Shallow fry potato cubes and cauliflower florets in 2 tbsp oil on medium-high flame until 70% cooked and golden. Remove to a plate.
In the same pan, crackle cumin seeds, then sauté onions and ginger-garlic paste until brown.
Add tomato puree, salt, turmeric, red chilli, and coriander powder. Cook until oil separates.
Add green peas, fried potatoes, cauliflower, and 1/4 cup warm water. Mix well.
Cover with lid and simmer on low flame for 6-8 minutes until vegetables are tender.
Sprinkle garam masala and fresh chopped coriander before serving hot with rotis.
recipes.jugaadTip: Frying potatoes and cauliflower first seals their shape so they don't turn mushy while simmering in the gravy!
recipes.substitutions: If cauliflower is unavailable, replace with paneer cubes or capsicum.

recipes.title: Instant Indori Masala Poha
ingredients: 2 Green Chillies slit, 1/2 tsp Mustard seeds, 1/2 tsp Fennel (Saunf)
1/2 tsp Turmeric, 1 tsp Sugar, Salt to taste
1 Lemon, Fresh coriander, Indori Sev for topping
instructions: Rinse poha in a colander under running water for 30 seconds. Drain completely and gently toss with 1/2 tsp salt and 1 tsp sugar. Let rest for 5 minutes.
Heat 1.5 tbsp oil in a pan, roast peanuts on medium-low flame until crunchy. Keep aside or leave in pan.
Add mustard seeds, saunf (fennel), and green chillies. Let crackle.
Add chopped onions and cook on medium flame until light pink (do not over-brown).
Add turmeric powder and mix, then add the fluffed drained poha.
Gently toss from edges to center on low flame. Cover with lid and steam for 2 minutes.
Turn off flame, add generous lemon juice, chopped coriander, and crunchy sev.
recipes.jugaadTip: Adding sugar and salt directly to rinsed raw poha before cooking ensures uniform sweet-tangy taste throughout every grain!
recipes.substitutions: If peanuts are missing, toss in roasted chana dal or boiled peas.

recipes.title: Comfort Masala Khichdi (One-Pot)
ingredients: 1/2 Cup Rice + 1/2 Cup Yellow Moong Dal (धोकर 10 मिनट भिगोएं)
1 tbsp Desi Ghee, 1 tsp Cumin (Jeera), 1 pinch Hing
instructions: Heat ghee in a pressure cooker. Add hing and cumin seeds; let them splutter.
Add chopped onion, tomato, and diced potato. Sauté for 2 minutes.
Add turmeric, salt, soaked rice, and dal. Sauté gently for 1 minute.
Pour in 3.5 cups of water and stir thoroughly.
Close pressure cooker lid and cook on medium flame for 3-4 whistles.
Allow pressure to release naturally. Stir and serve piping hot with ghee, papad, and pickle.
recipes.jugaadTip: A pinch of hing (asafoetida) in desi ghee makes the khichdi super easy to digest and creates an irresistible aroma!
recipes.substitutions: Can use Toor Dal or Masoor Dal if Moong Dal is not on hand.

recipes.title: Leftover Rice Lemon Masala Pulao
recipes.titleHindi: बचे हुए चावल का चटपटा लेमन पुलाव
ingredients: 2 Cups Cooked Leftover Rice (बचे हुए ठंडे चावल)
1 tsp Mustard seeds, Curry leaves, 1 Green Chilli
instructions: Gently separate cold leftover rice grains with your fingers so no lumps remain.
Heat 1.5 tbsp oil in a pan, fry peanuts until golden brown.
Add mustard seeds, curry leaves, and green chillies. Let crackle.
Add sliced onions and sauté on medium heat until translucent.
Add turmeric powder and salt, followed by the cooked rice.
Toss lightly on medium-low flame for 3-4 minutes until heated through.
Turn off flame and mix in freshly squeezed lemon juice.
recipes.jugaadTip: Cold refrigerated rice works 10x better than fresh hot rice because the starch is firm and grains won't break into a mush!
recipes.substitutions: Add any leftover dry sabzi directly into the rice for an instant masala tahri.

recipes.title: High-Protein Besan Cheela
ingredients: 1/2 tsp Carom Seeds (Ajwain crushed between palms)
1/4 tsp Haldi, 1/2 tsp Salt, Water to make smooth pourable batter
1 tbsp Oil or Ghee for shallow cooking
instructions: In a bowl, mix besan, ajwain, turmeric, and salt. Add water gradually, whisking to form a smooth, lump-free dosa-like batter.
Stir in chopped onions, tomatoes, chillies, and coriander.
Heat a non-stick tawa on medium heat and brush lightly with oil.
Pour a ladleful of batter in center and spread evenly in circular motion.
Drizzle a few drops of oil around edges and cook for 2 minutes until bottom is golden and crispy.
Flip and cook the second side for 1-2 minutes pressing gently.
Serve hot with tomato ketchup or green mint chutney.
recipes.jugaadTip: Always crush Ajwain between palms before adding—it enhances aroma tenfold and aids quick digestion of gram flour!
recipes.substitutions: Grate 2 tbsp paneer on top right after flipping for a luxury Paneer Cheela.

recipes.title: Jeera Aloo (10-Minute Bachelor Special)
ingredients: 3 Boiled or Thinly Sliced Potatoes (उबले या पतले कटे आलू)
2 Slit Green Chillies, 1 inch grated Ginger
Spices: 1/2 tsp Haldi, 1 tsp Coriander powder, 1/2 tsp Amchur (Dry Mango powder), Salt
2 tbsp Mustard oil or Refined oil
instructions: Heat mustard oil in a pan until it smokes slightly, then lower flame.
Add generous cumin seeds and let them sizzle into a deep nutty brown.
Add slit chillies and ginger; sauté for 30 seconds.
Add sliced potatoes, sprinkle haldi, dhania powder, amchur, and salt.
Roast on medium flame uncovered for 5-7 minutes, flipping occasionally until golden crust forms on potato edges.
Garnish with coriander and lemon juice. Perfect with hot puris or parathas!
recipes.jugaadTip: Adding 1/2 tsp Amchur (dry mango powder) or chaat masala right at the end turns simple potatoes into an addictive street-style delicacy!
recipes.substitutions: If amchur is unavailable, squeeze 1/2 fresh lemon.

recipes.title: Quick Egg Bhurji (Street Style)
ingredients: 2 Green Chillies, 1 tbsp Butter + 1 tbsp Oil
1/4 tsp Haldi, 1/2 tsp Pav Bhaji Masala or Garam Masala, Salt
instructions: Crack eggs into a bowl, whisk lightly with a pinch of salt.
Heat butter and oil in a pan. Sauté chopped onions and chillies on medium flame until golden brown.
Add tomatoes, salt, turmeric, and pav bhaji masala. Cook until tomatoes turn soft and pulpy.
Pour in the whisked eggs on medium-low flame.
Scramble continuously with a spatula for 2-3 minutes until soft, fluffy curds form.
Do not overcook until dry. Garnish with coriander and serve immediately with toasted pav or roti.
recipes.jugaadTip: A half teaspoon of Pav Bhaji masala gives standard egg bhurji that famous Mumbai roadside buttery flavor!
recipes.substitutions: Replace eggs with 200g crumbled Paneer for pure vegetarian Paneer Bhurji.
